parameters.query:
WITH active_projects AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, p.budget_target, p.current_phase
    FROM projects p
   WHERE p.current_phase NOT IN ('completed','archived','intake','briefing_done')
), proj_costs AS (
  SELECT ce.project_id, ce.total_estimated AS estimated
    FROM cost_estimates ce
    JOIN active_projects ap ON ap.id = ce.project_id
   WHERE ce.id IN (
     SELECT DISTINCT ON (project_id) id FROM cost_estimates ORDER BY project_id, version DESC
   )
), proj_invoices AS (
  SELECT i.project_id,
         sum(i.total_amount)                            AS total_facturado,
         sum(i.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE i.paid_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_pagado,
         count(*)                                       AS num_facturas,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status='pending_review') AS pending_review,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status='disputed')    AS disputed,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.ocr_confidence='low') AS low_confidence
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN active_projects ap ON ap.id = i.project_id
   GROUP BY i.project_id
), proj_certs AS (
  SELECT c.project_id,
         sum(c.amount)                                  AS total_certificado,
         sum(c.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE c.paid_amount IS NOT NULL) AS total_cobrado
    FROM certifications c
    JOIN active_projects ap ON ap.id = c.project_id
   WHERE c.status != 'cancelled'
   GROUP BY c.project_id
)
SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.deviation_pct DESC NULLS LAST) AS report
FROM (
  SELECT
    ap.id AS project_id, ap.name AS project_name, ap.current_phase,
    pc.estimated, ap.budget_target,
    COALESCE(pi.total_facturado, 0)   AS total_facturado,
    COALESCE(pi.total_pagado, 0)      AS total_pagado,
    COALESCE(pi.num_facturas, 0)      AS num_facturas,
    COALESCE(pi.pending_review, 0)    AS pending_review,
    COALESCE(pi.disputed, 0)          AS disputed,
    COALESCE(pi.low_confidence, 0)    AS low_confidence,
    COALESCE(pcert.total_certificado, 0) AS total_certificado,
    COALESCE(pcert.total_cobrado, 0)     AS total_cobrado,
    CASE
      WHEN pc.estimated IS NULL OR pc.estimated = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE round(((COALESCE(pi.total_facturado, 0) - pc.estimated) / pc.estimated * 100)::numeric, 2)
    END AS deviation_pct,
    COALESCE(pcert.total_certificado, 0) - COALESCE(pi.total_facturado, 0) AS margin_now
  FROM active_projects ap
  LEFT JOIN proj_costs pc       ON pc.project_id = ap.id
  LEFT JOIN proj_invoices pi    ON pi.project_id = ap.id
  LEFT JOIN proj_certs pcert    ON pcert.project_id = ap.id
) t;
